product.highlights:
• Did you know that mishappen produce are often misunderstood to be of 'inferior' quality and thus thrown away when in fact, they are just as good in taste and nutritional value as those that made the grocery shelves?
  • The Wonky Fruits & Vegetables Cutting Set aims to fight the battle against food wastage through awareness and action. Like its predecessors, this fruit cutting set provides the full host of developmental benefits from fine motor skills to early literacy and imaginative thinking - but with an extra message: to educate our young about World Food Wastage.
  • This meaningful play set is a joint project between PlanToys and Kromkommer, a Dutch initiative armed with a mission to increase awareness of food wastage in the world and save all the fruits and veggies that would otherwise have been thrown away because of their appearance or overproduction. (Instead of ending up in the bin, these ‘wonkies’ are saved and used in the production of soups, or even sold at its unique ‘Wonky Fruit & Vegetables Store’ in Holland.) For every set sold, PlanToys donates €1 to Kromkommer's efforts to battle food wastage.
  • Great for developing hand grip and muscle strength through grasping, hand-eye coordination language and communicative skills, creativity and imagination, and self-directed learning through play.
  • Constructed from sustainable PlanWood™, a unique eco material which combines leftover wood waste with organic coloured pigments and E-zero Glue at intensive pressures to achieve a mouldable, hardy & water-proof wooden material; making it the safer and greener choice for growing tots!
  • Coated with non-toxic, water-based/organic pigments and dyes making it safe for teething little ones to gnaw on.
  • Plan Toys uses sustainable, ethically sourced Rubberwood for all of their toys, meaning safe play for children while knowing we are protecting the environment too.
  • Product measures: 3x9x6.2 cm

13795193880.title: Leezen Super Rainbow Fruit & Vegetable Drink (25g x 20 pkt)
13795193880.detail_text: About Product Leezen's Super Rainbow Fruit & Vegetable Drink packs over 30 varieties of fruits, vegetables, and super-grains into each of its 20 individual 25g sachets - spinach, kale, broccoli, carrot, beetroot, purple sweet potato, apple, pineapple, berries, brown rice, barley, flaxseed, and soy protein among them, built around the "rainbow diet" principle of eating across colours to get a full spectrum of antioxidants, flavonoids, and carotenoids. Rather than the filtered sugars and low fibre of commercial fruit juices, low-temperature dehydration keeps the plants' structural integrity intact, so the dietary fibre and natural enzymes carry through into every glass. Just mix a sachet with 200-250ml of room-temperature or cold water and shake - avoid boiling water, which can break down the live enzymes. No synthetic colouring, artificial fragrances, or chemical preservatives. Contains soy and gluten (from barley). Product of Taiwan.

3202016152.detail_text: COMPLETE VARIETY - A Colourful selection of pretend play food, sliceable fruits and vegetables. FEEL THE QUALITY - Made from the highest quality wood that's durable, safe, and crush-resistant. Adorable and realistic cutting fruits and vegetables set in bright shining colours to enchant even the very young toddlers. A DELICIOUS WAY TO LEARN - In addition to teaching fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination, this play toy food set encourages imaginative and independent play - and even introduces the concept of fractions. A kid can use the wooden knife to cut up the fruits/veggies and count all the pieces, then you can talk together about cutting them in half; cutting them in thirds. ENHANCE - Kids can enjoy playing with the bright coloured foods, cutting them on the chopping block. Invite early dramatic play, enhance vocabularies and reinforce healthy eating with familiar looking produce. GREAT SET OR ADDITION TO ANY TOY KITCHEN - Give this play toy food set as a gift to just about any kid! 3541484699.detail_text: Storage Method Recommendation (Bottle Gourd): Room Temperature (Short-Term): If you plan to use bottle gourd within a day or two, you can keep it at room temperature in a cool and dry place, away from direct sunlight. Refrigeration: For longer storage, keep the whole, uncut bottle gourd in the vegetable crisper drawer of the refrigerator. Wrap it lightly in a paper towel and place it in a perforated plastic bag to maintain freshness and avoid excess moisture. Cut Bottle Gourd: Once cut, store the pieces in an airtight container or zip-lock bag in the refrigerator. It’s best to use them within 2–3 days to retain texture and flavor. Avoid Moisture: Do not wash before storing. Wash only before use to prevent moisture buildup and premature spoilage. Freezing: Bottle gourd can be frozen after peeling, chopping, and blanching for 2–3 minutes. Once cooled, pack in airtight freezer bags. Frozen bottle gourd can last up to 6–8 months but may soften slightly when cooked.
3541484699.detail_html:
Storage Method Recommendation (Bottle Gourd):

  1. Room Temperature (Short-Term): If you plan to use bottle gourd within a day or two, you can keep it at room temperature in a cool and dry place, away from direct sunlight.
  2. Refrigeration: For longer storage, keep the whole, uncut bottle gourd in the vegetable crisper drawer of the refrigerator. Wrap it lightly in a paper towel and place it in a perforated plastic bag to maintain freshness and avoid excess moisture.
  3. Cut Bottle Gourd: Once cut, store the pieces in an airtight container or zip-lock bag in the refrigerator. It’s best to use them within 2–3 days to retain texture and flavor.
  4. Avoid Moisture: Do not wash before storing. Wash only before use to prevent moisture buildup and premature spoilage.
  5. Freezing: Bottle gourd can be frozen after peeling, chopping, and blanching for 2–3 minutes. Once cooled, pack in airtight freezer bags. Frozen bottle gourd can last up to 6–8 months but may soften slightly when cooked.

2781572918.detail_text: Bt Worm & Caterpillar Killer is a bacterium which is selectively toxic to many moths and butterfly larvae (caterpillars). The insects stop feeding and die within 2-3 days of ingestion. Bt Worm & Caterpillar Killer may be applied up to the day of harvest. It helps to control worms and caterpillars on fruits, vegetables, ornamentals and shade trees. Apply using hose-end or pressurised sprayers, up to the day of harvest. The normal mixture is 15-25ml / 20 Litres of water. Controls many pests including the redhumped caterpillars, cabbage looper, tomato hornworms, tent caterpillars, gypsy moths, omnivorous and fruit tree leaf roller. Ingredients: Bacillus thuringiensis subspecies kurstalo strain SA-12solids, spores and Lepidopteran active toxins (At least 6 million viable spores per mg) - 15.0% Other Ingredients - 85.0%
